I've reviewed the draft plan, and I see Mr. Hall is assigned to all five chemistry class periods with lab work postponed. Before I can approve this and post it to the faculty coverage system, I'd like the department chair, certification officer, and counselor to review the draft for any operational concerns. Does anyone see any issues with assigning a mathematics teacher to five straight days of chemistry coverage?
